purpose: Explain the supported product story in a short, useful narrative.

editorial_guidelines.tone: Use the retrieved PMM voice, adapted to this channel; no fixed writing script.
guidance: Use a descriptive title, a clear introduction, explanatory sections and a concise conclusion/CTA.
Prefer two or three useful sections; do not pad the draft to reach a word target or repeat unsupported details.
No invented interviews, taste-test experiences, product history, expert bylines or testimonials.

review_criteria: The article explains the flavor/story clearly with logical headings and useful substance.
Qualifications and variant/market distinctions survive the narrative; no invented firsthand experience.
